row.evidence: Atlan's docs say 'Atlan supports SCIM 2.0 with Azure AD / Entra and Okta. SSO must be configured first', but atlan.com/pricing redirects to a talk-to-sales form, so no plan or price for SCIM is public.
row.notes: New row. SCIM 2.0 exists (bearer token generated under Settings > SSO, base URL https://{tenant-dns}/api/service/scim, token never expires) and is documented for Entra ID and Okta via the customer's own SAML app; SSO is required first. Status is unknown, not gated, because Atlan publishes no plans or prices: atlan.com/pricing redirects to a sales contact form and no docs page names a plan for SCIM or SSO. Deprovisioning sets the user to Disabled, and deactivated users do not count toward licences. Google Workspace, OneLogin and JumpCloud are documented for SAML SSO only. JIT account creation on first SSO sign-in is on by default. A REST user/group API (invite, list, role change, group membership, delete) is documented through the SDK guides; deactivation is UI-only.

plans.name: Custom (Contact Sales)
plans.price_text: No public pricing; atlan.com/pricing redirects to a talk-to-sales form

auth.token_source: Settings > SSO > (Azure AD or Okta provider) > Overview > Automate Provisioning with SCIM > + Generate token
auth.notes: Token is shown once. Removing the Atlan user who created a SCIM token deletes that token.

operations.notes: Docs describe attribute updates (Entra and Okta 'Push Profile Updates') but do not say whether PUT or PATCH is used. No SCIM user delete is documented: removal in the IdP deactivates; permanent removal is a manual admin action. Group push links to existing Atlan groups that are already mapped in SSO settings.

deprovision.data_retained: User is set to Disabled and keeps assets; an admin can later remove (hard-delete) the user and transfer ownership of assets.

attributes.notes: Attribute list from the Entra default mappings; the Okta guide maps firstName, lastName and email. Group displayName mapping is 'currently unsupported in Atlan'.

limitations.text: SCIM is documented only for Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) and Okta.
Username and email are synced only once at provisioning; username changes in the IdP do not propagate and need Atlan support.
Deactivation fails silently if the IdP does not send externalId.
With SCIM on, admins cannot disable or reactivate SCIM-managed users inside Atlan.
Entra syncs on its ~40-minute provisioning cycle.

scim.notes: No public pricing or plan list exists (atlan.com/pricing redirects to a talk-to-sales form), so the plan that includes SCIM is not public. Base URL as given in the Entra and Okta guides (Okta guide adds a trailing slash).

auth.notes: API tokens are scoped by personas; deleting a user requires an admin user's bearer token, not an API token.

capabilities.notes: Creating a user sends an invitation. Deactivate/reactivate are UI-only for admins. Delete is a permanent hard-delete with asset transfer (SDK RemoveUser). Roles: $admin, $member, $guest set by role GUID.

audit_log_api.notes: Asset audit search (POST /api/meta/entity/auditSearch) covers asset write/mutation events; authentication events are streamed via OTLP to a customer bucket rather than a query API.

limitations.text: API tokens cannot deactivate or reactivate users; user deletion needs an admin user's bearer token.

user_api.notes: Documented as the 'Raw REST API' tab of the Atlan SDK users-and-groups guides (Java, Python, Kotlin, Go SDKs wrap the same calls). No public plan list, so the plan with API access is not public.

okta.notes: Atlan's guides build a custom SAML 2.0 app in Okta and switch its Provisioning to SCIM; okta.com/integrations/atlan/ returned 404, so no OIN catalogue app was found.

entra.notes: Configured on the customer's own Atlan SAML enterprise application; Microsoft Learn atlan-tutorial and atlan-provisioning-tutorial returned 404.

google.notes: Atlan documents a custom Google Workspace SAML app for SSO only; SCIM is documented for Azure AD and Okta only.

onelogin.notes: Atlan's own OneLogin SAML guide; no provisioning documented. OneLogin catalogue not loaded.

jumpcloud.notes: Atlan's own JumpCloud SAML guide; no provisioning documented. jumpcloud.com/support/integrate-with-atlan returned 403.

fallbacks.other_sync: Group sync from the IdP at SSO login (group mapping) without SCIM.
